deviations_from_card: FIRST PAINT: the card's code kept in lib/voice.ts measured 165,671 B gz against a 165,410 B run base (with siblings' in-flight edits) and a 165,412 B ceiling, so it was 259 B over. Remedy per the brief: Player moved to a NEW file apps/desktop/src/lib/voice-player.ts, loaded with import() in ensureSocket (VoiceDeps.player may return a promise). The module has NO runtime imports: lib/voice.ts exports PLAYER_KIT {follow, pcm16ToFloat32, rms}, passed as the Player's second constructor arg. A first try that imported lib/voice from the lazy module made rolldown split lib/voice and lib/events into their own chunks (net +80 B). Final first paint is 164,936 B (474 B under the run base, 476 B headroom). Write set grew by that one source file plus test-only edits: lib/face-signal.test.ts (Player import and kit; the acceptance pinned the old early idle after voice.stopped done and now expects 'speaking' through the tail and idle on quiet), e2e/voice.e2e.test.ts (type import moved, fake player gains silence()). Guard case 8 is the existing stores/voice.test.ts test 'a line the daemon began speaking as the key went down...', which still passes. Two extra tests beyond the cases: onQuiet, and a queued second line.
